title: Payment Processing Policy
description: Guidelines for handling customer payment issues
rules: All payment disputes must be investigated within 24 hours. Refunds require manager approval for amounts OVER $100. Agents CANNOT approve refunds over $100 without manager sign-off. Payment investigations must be documented with case ID.

title: Account Access Policy
description: Procedures for account lockouts and password resets
rules: Password resets require email verification — agents CANNOT reset passwords without identity verification. Account lockouts after 5 failed attempts require manual unlock by agent. Account suspension can only be lifted by supervisor. Agents CANNOT share account credentials over chat.

title: System Maintenance Policy
description: Guidelines for system maintenance and downtime
rules: All maintenance must be scheduled during off-peak hours (2am-6am). Customers must be notified 48 hours in advance. Agents CANNOT promise uptime guarantees beyond the stated 99.5% SLA. Compensation for downtime exceeding 4 hours is one extra day of service credit only.

title: Refund Policy
rules: Full refunds ONLY available within 30 days of purchase — agents CANNOT offer full refunds after 30 days under any circumstances. Partial refunds (up to 50%) may be offered for service disruptions within 60 days. Refunds over $500 require CFO approval. Digital/downloaded products are NON-refundable after access. Agents CANNOT promise refunds outside these windows.

title: Data Privacy Policy
description: Customer data handling and privacy protection
rules: Customer data CANNOT be shared with any third party without explicit written consent. All data access must be logged and audited. Agents CANNOT read or share another customer's account details. GDPR deletion requests must be fulfilled within 30 days — agents cannot delay this. Agents CANNOT store customer passwords.

title: Communication Policy
rules: All communications must be professional and empathetic. Response time MUST NOT exceed 24 hours — agents cannot promise faster unless escalated. Agents CANNOT make promises not backed by policy (e.g. 'we'll fix it today'). All commitments made to customers must be documented.

title: Security Policy
rules: All systems require multi-factor authentication. Security incidents must be reported immediately — agents CANNOT delay incident reporting. Agents CANNOT bypass MFA for any customer. Suspected fraud must be escalated immediately — agents cannot handle fraud cases independently.

title: Subscription Policy
rules: Subscription changes take effect at the NEXT billing cycle — agents CANNOT make immediate plan changes mid-cycle. Cancellations require 30-day notice for annual plans. Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime but NO pro-rated refund for current month. Agents CANNOT offer free months without supervisor approval.

title: Compensation Policy
description: Rules for offering service credits and compensation
rules: Service credits can ONLY be offered for verified outages or errors caused by the company. Maximum credit an agent can offer without approval: 1 month free (value up to $50). Credits over $50 require supervisor approval. Agents CANNOT offer cash compensation — only service credits. No compensation for issues caused by customer error.

title: VIP Account Policy
description: Special handling for VIP and enterprise customers
rules: VIP accounts must receive response within 4 hours. Dedicated account manager must be looped in on all VIP issues. Agents CANNOT make decisions on VIP accounts without account manager approval. VIP accounts get priority refund processing within 48 hours.

title: Escalation Policy
description: When and how to escalate customer issues
rules: MUST escalate if: customer threatens legal action, refund request over $500, security breach suspected, customer contacts media, 3rd failed resolution attempt. Agents CANNOT continue handling a case after legal threat — immediately escalate to legal team. Escalation must be documented with full case notes.

title: Known Issues Policy
description: Handling reports of known product bugs or outages
rules: Agents must check the known issues registry before investigating. If issue is a known bug, inform customer of ETA and log as affected. Agents CANNOT promise a bug fix date not officially communicated by engineering. Compensation for known issues: 1 day service credit per 4 hours of downtime (max 7 days).
